security.note: No new groups; 13 record rules scope subcontracting MOs/BoMs/pickings/moves to the portal subcontractor (subcontractor_id) so a vendor sees only its own work.

behavioral_notes.observation: The module adds a 'subcontract' value to mrp.bom.type plus a subcontractor_ids Many2many to res.partner; a constraint (_check_subcontracting_no_operation) forbids operations or by-products on such BoMs. _bom_subcontract_find resolves the recipe for a (product, subcontractor) pair by AND-ing the standard _bom_find_domain with ('subcontractor_ids','parent_of',subcontractor.ids), so a vendor's commercial parent matches its contact. This BoM type is the marker that turns a vendor receipt into a backing production.

When an incoming move from a supplier location matches a subcontract BoM (_get_subcontract_bom), the move is flagged is_subcontract=True and its source rewritten to the subcontracting_location (partner.property_stock_subcontractor or company.subcontracting_location_id). After super()._action_confirm, _subcontracted_produce groups receipt moves by company and creates one mrp.production per move (subcontractor_id = picking partner's commercial_partner, src=dest=subcontracting location, picking_type=warehouse.subcontracting_type_id), confirms it, and links the MO's finished move_dest_ids back to the receipt move. So receiving a subcontracted product auto-creates and back-links a real mrp.production invisible in field metadata.

Each warehouse gets a 'Resupply Subcontractor' route (subcontracting_route_id) plus an MTS pull rule (subcontracting_pull_id) and an MTO pull rule (subcontracting_mto_pull_id, global route route_resupply_subcontractor_mto) that move supplied components from lot_stock to the subcontracting location via an internal 'Resupply Subcontractor' operation type (subcontracting_resupply_type_id). _update_resupply_rules archives/unarchives these rules per the subcontracting_to_resupply flag. stock.move._get_partner_id stamps the subcontractor as the resupply move's partner so components ship to the vendor; _should_bypass_reservation returns True for subcontract receipt moves (the vendor holds the stock).

behavioral_notes.element: stock.picking._action_done -> production.button_mark_done (record production from the receipt)
behavioral_notes.observation: Validating the subcontract receipt picking calls button_mark_done on each linked production (sudo), consuming supplied components out of the subcontracting location and producing the finished good into it, then dates the production raw/finished moves one second before the receipt for traceability. Tracked components/lots are recorded via stock.move.action_show_details (move_line_raw_ids 'Record Production' wizard); _sync_subcontracting_productions keeps MO quantities and per-lot productions in sync with the receipt move (splitting MOs per lot, change.production.qty for untracked).

Adds 10 JS files and a dedicated mrp_subcontracting.webclient asset bundle (84 entries) plus a SubcontractingPortalWebClient OWL component and 3 portal routes (/my/productions...). The vendor logs in as a portal user to record components and lots/serials against the MO directly; record rules + _is_subcontractor/_get_writeable_fields_portal_user gate this. The module also patches the backend BoM Overview (BomOverviewLine/SpecialLine/ComponentsBlock) and SMLX2ManyField to surface subcontracting detail.

information_flows: side-effect: stock.move._action_confirm (incoming + subcontract BoM) -> picking._subcontracted_produce -> creates & confirms backing mrp.production, links finished move to receipt move
side-effect: stock.warehouse resupply routes -> stock.rule -> internal transfer ships supplied components to the subcontracting location (vendor)
side-effect: stock.picking._action_done (receipt validated) -> production.button_mark_done -> consumes components + produces finished good in subcontracting location + dates moves for traceability

flow: tracked components / lots recorded via stock.move.action_show_details (move_line_raw_ids wizard) or the subcontractor portal (/my/productions) -> _sync_subcontracting_productions keeps MO qty/lots in sync

Record Subcontracted Production (components, lots/serials) on receipt

value_streams: Outsource-to-Receive: subcontract demand -> components resupplied to vendor location (resupply route) -> vendor produces finished good -> receive finished good (stock.move is_subcontract) -> backing mrp.production auto-created -> record components/lots (backend or portal) -> validate receipt -> button_mark_done consumes components + produces finished good + values output
organization: (no new security groups; reuses mrp groups: group_mrp_user, group_mrp_manager)
Portal subcontractor (res.users portal, gated by is_subcontractor + record rules)
policies: 13 record rules scoping subcontracting MOs/BoMs/pickings/moves to the portal subcontractor (subcontractor_id) — a vendor sees only its own work
_check_subcontracting_no_operation: subcontract BoMs may not carry operations or by-products

classification.rationale: mrp_subcontracting is the outsourced segment of the Make/manufacturing value chain (Stabell & Fjeldstad 'chain'): the transform step that converts supplied component inputs into a finished-goods output is performed by an external subcontractor rather than in-house work centers, but it is still modeled as a real mrp.production that consumes raw and produces finished stock.moves, updating inventory and valuation. It is a primary activity sitting between procurement/resupply (inbound to the vendor) and the finished-good receipt (inbound to own stock). Per apqc_odoo_map.tsv it maps to APQC 4.3 Produce/Manufacture/Deliver Product, specifically 4.3.1.4 (schedule production orders: the backing mrp.production created by _subcontracted_produce) and 4.3.1.7 (release production orders: action_confirm on that MO) — subcontracted production. It has no work orders or finite scheduling (subcontract BoMs forbid operations); execution happens at the vendor and is reconciled on the receipt.

standard_capabilities: Subcontracting BoM (type=subcontract) with one or more subcontractor partners
Automatic backing MO created and back-linked on receipt of a subcontracted product
Component resupply to the subcontractor via MTS/MTO routes and an internal operation type
Record of consumed components and lot/serial tracking on the subcontracting MO
Subcontractor self-service portal (/my/productions) to record production remotely
Subcontracting stock tracked at a dedicated per-vendor or per-company location
Component cost rolled into the value of the received finished good
BoM Overview augmented with subcontracting detail
typical_fits: Vendor assembles/produces a finished good from components you supply (toll/contract manufacturing)
Vendor produces from its own components (combine with mrp_subcontracting_purchase for the PO/cost flow)
Drop-ship style: supplied components shipped directly to the subcontractor on order (MTO resupply)
Outsourced production with lot/serial traceability of components and output
common_gaps: Purchase/cost integration (vendor pricing, PO, bill) is a separate module mrp_subcontracting_purchase
Quality control checks on subcontracted receipts (quality_mrp)
No work orders / finite scheduling for the outsourced step (subcontract BoMs forbid operations)
Multi-step subcontracting receipt routes / custom resupply topologies need warehouse config
Account valuation specifics (continental vs anglo-saxon) for subcontracting services
